Flow.description: DWDECI-43. On new Partner Expansion / Amendment Opportunity creation, defaults Facility_MOU_Required__c to unchecked if the parent Account's MOU_Level__c is Corporate Level (stays checked/default otherwise). Before-save fast field update - no DML. Checks the Global, Object (Opportunity), and Automation kill switches from ACC Base Utilities. NOTE: the Record Type check is done via a Decision on $Record.RecordType.DeveloperName rather than a Start filter, per the established pattern in this org (a RecordType.DeveloperName cross-object Start filter deploys and activates cleanly but throws an unhandled runtime exception on every trigger in this org - see Opportunity_On_Edit_Apply_Warm_Handoff_Action_Plan). No fault-path error logging: Salesforce disallows Action elements entirely in Record-Run-Before-Save flows, so a Get Parent Account failure surfaces as a standard Salesforce save error to the user rather than an Error_Log__c record.
Flow.interviewLabel: Opportunity - On Create - Default MOU Requirement {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: Opportunity - On Create - Default MOU Requirement
